comment: Shot list of the starter's example film, a short piece on making a cup of tea. Bars are bars of the music, counted from zero, four beats to a bar; fractions are allowed. Shots follow each other without a gap. `in` is the transition that leads into a shot; `lead` and `tail` are in beats. Two shots in a row that come in by the same transition, or make the same camera move, are warned about; `"repeat": true` on the later shot says the repetition is intended and silences that warning. Group kinds: title, section, recap, end. A caption's `kind` names one sentence in the `lines` of its section in copy.json; `how` is plate, shot or none; a plate needs a `place` (top, middle, bottom). Run `bun run shots` (or `python3 scripts/build-shot-files.py`) after every change.

punch.label: Cut with a punch-in
punch.what: The new shot jumps one step closer and settles back.

invert.label: Cut with two inverted frames
invert.what: The first two frames of the new shot are inverted, with a jolt.

flash.label: Cut with a flash
flash.what: A flash that dies away in less than half a beat.

whip.label: Whip
whip.what: The old shot smears in one direction and the new one comes out of the smear, within half a beat.

push.label: Push
push.what: The new shot pushes the old one out of the frame, with a dark seam between them.

caret.label: Caret wipe
caret.what: The caret of the film sweeps across the frame; behind it is the new shot.

tiles.label: Tiles
tiles.what: The frame is a wall of square tiles that turn over from one corner.

crt.label: Television off
crt.what: The picture collapses to a line and a dot; the new shot switches on from that line.

rewind.label: Tape rewind
rewind.what: The picture tears into bands, the colours split and the frame rolls.

implode.label: Implode
implode.what: INTO A DROP. The picture swirls into one point. Breath: one dot of signal. Impact: a shock wave from that dot.

stutter.label: Stutter into a slit
stutter.what: INTO A DROP. The shot repeats itself in slices that halve every beat while the frame closes to a slit. Breath: one line of light. Impact: the slit bursts open.

tunnel.label: Tunnel
tunnel.what: INTO A DROP. The frame holds a smaller copy of itself, and that one another; the camera rushes in. Breath: white. Impact: a shock wave.

breath.label: Held breath
breath.what: INTO A DROP AFTER A SILENCE. The picture loses its colour, darkens and closes round a point. Impact: three shock waves.

stretch.label: Stretch
stretch.what: INTO A DROP. Columns of pixels stretch into streaks and the frame inverts with the drum roll. Impact: the streaks fall, two shock waves.

slices.label: Slices
slices.what: The frame is cut into bands that slide out to both sides, staggered.

spin.label: Spin
spin.what: The frame turns round a point; the new shot arrives while it is still turning.

stepzoom.label: Three-step zoom
stepzoom.what: Three hard punch-ins on sixteenth notes, each with a colour split and a tilt; the new shot steps back out twice.

through.label: Through a letter
through.what: IN-WORLD. A large letter stands in front of the camera, which goes through its hole; on the other side is the new shot.

shatter.label: Shatter
shatter.what: IN-WORLD. A thing of the old shot flies at the lens; where it hits, the frame breaks and falls away onto the new shot.

zoom-in.label: Into a detail
zoom-in.what: IN-WORLD. The new shot is already held in a detail of the old one; the camera goes into it until it fills the frame.

pull-out.label: Out of a detail
pull-out.what: IN-WORLD. The old shot turns out to be a detail of the new one; the camera pulls back and shows the larger world.

travel.label: Camera journey
travel.what: IN-WORLD. Two shots are two places in one world; the camera travels from one to the other.

match.label: Match cut
match.what: IN-WORLD. The last picture of one shot and the first of the next share a shape.

groups.label: Title
groups.shape: Two bars of the intro: the name of the film lands on the downbeat of the second bar.

groups.name: Water
groups.shape: Problem first, in the bars before the drums. The name arrives with the answer, one bar in.

groups.name: Steep
groups.shape: Answer first: the name lands on the drop, and the shots after it explain why.

groups.label: Recap
groups.shape: Both names once more, one beat each, then the cup.

groups.label: End card
groups.shape: The one sentence to take away, held to the end of the track.

shots.title: The name of the film
shots.see: A dark table seen from above, one empty cup at its centre. The name of the film, A BETTER CUP, stands behind the cup in type as tall as the frame.
shots.move: First bar: the cup alone, steam rising on each beat. Second bar: one word of the name on each of its first three beats.
shots.camera: Locked off, the frame gives a little on each word
shots.look: Full-frame type behind a drawn object

shots.title: Too hot
shots.see: A kettle at a rolling boil pours straight onto green leaves in a glass cup. The leaves curl and turn brown from the edges.
shots.move: The pour starts on beat one. The leaves darken one step on every beat of the second bar.
shots.camera: Pushes in slowly towards the cup

shots.title: Let it rest
shots.see: The kettle is lifted off the stove and set down. A thermometer beside it falls from 100 to 80 as the bubbles in the kettle stop one by one.
shots.move: One bubble stops on every beat. The thermometer steps down five degrees on each downbeat.
shots.look: Line drawing with one signal colour

shots.title: The right pour
shots.see: The rested water pours onto fresh leaves. They open slowly and stay green.
shots.move: The pour on beat one. A leaf opens on each beat after it.
shots.camera: Locked off, close on the cup

shots.title: Three minutes
shots.see: A sand timer turns over on the drop. The word STEEP fills the frame behind it.
shots.move: The timer turns on the first beat of the drop. Sand falls in time with the kick.
shots.camera: Punches in on the drop, then drifts back
shots.look: Bold type and a drawn object, high contrast

shots.title: Colour spreads

in.note: The camera goes into the glass of the sand timer; the next shot is the cup seen through that glass.

shots.see: Seen from above, colour spreads from the leaves through the water in rings, from pale to deep amber. A small label on the cup reads the sentence.
shots.camera: Sinks slowly from above towards the water

shots.title: Out on time
shots.see: The timer runs out and rings. The leaves are lifted out of the cup in one move.
shots.move: The ring on the first beat of the third bar. The lift on the downbeat after it.
shots.camera: Tilts up with the lifted leaves
shots.look: Line drawing with one signal colour

shots.title: Water, steep
shots.see: The two names, WATER and STEEP, one on each beat of the first bar, then the finished cup.
shots.move: One name per beat, the cup on the downbeat of the second bar.

shots.title: Take away
shots.see: The closing sentence, set large, and the cup beside it.
shots.move: One line of the sentence on each downbeat.

captions.why: The cup and the leaves fill the lower half. It starts one beat in, after the whip has settled.
The kettle and the thermometer stand in the upper two thirds.
The leaves stay green: the picture says it.
Starts after the impact of the drop, so it can be read.
The label on the cup carries the sentence.
The lifted leaves leave the middle of the frame empty.
